&nbsp; &nbsp; var C_kdf = C.kdf = {};<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var OpenSSLKdf = C_kdf.OpenSSL = {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;execute: function (password, keySize, ivSize, salt, hasher) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;if (!salt) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; salt = WordArray.random(64 / 8);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;if (!hasher) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; var key = EvpKDF.create({<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;keySize: keySize + ivSize<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; }).compute(password, salt);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;} else {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; var key = EvpKDF.create({<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;keySize: keySize + ivSize,<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;hasher: hasher<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; }).compute(password, salt);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var iv = WordArray.create(key.words.slice(keySize), ivSize * 4);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;key.sigBytes = keySize * 4;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;return CipherParams.create({<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; key: key,<br>

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; salt: salt<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;});<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; };<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var PasswordBasedCipher = C_lib.PasswordBasedCipher = SerializableCipher.extend({<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;cfg: SerializableCipher.cfg.extend({<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;kdf: OpenSSLKdf<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}),<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;encrypt: function (cipher, message, password, cfg) {<br>

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var derivedParams = cfg.kdf.execute(password, cipher.keySize, cipher.ivSize, cfg.salt, cfg.hasher);<br>

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;ciphertext.mixIn(derivedParams);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;return ciphertext;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}, decrypt: function (cipher, ciphertext, password, cfg) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;cfg = this.cfg.extend(cfg);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;ciphertext = this._parse(ciphertext, cfg.format);<br>

<br>
(function () {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var C = CryptoJS;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var C_lib = C.lib;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var BlockCipher = C_lib.BlockCipher;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var C_algo = C.algo;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var SBOX = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var INV_SBOX = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var SUB_MIX_0 = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var SUB_MIX_1 = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var SUB_MIX_2 = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var SUB_MIX_3 = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var INV_SUB_MIX_0 = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var INV_SUB_MIX_1 = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var INV_SUB_MIX_2 = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var INV_SUB_MIX_3 = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; (function () {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var d = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;for (var i = 0; i &lt; 256; i++) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;if (i &lt; 128) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; d[i] = i &lt;&lt; 1;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;} else {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; d[i] = (i &lt;&lt; 1) ^ 0x11b;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var x = 0;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var xi = 0;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;for (var i = 0; i &lt; 256; i++) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var sx = xi ^ (xi &lt;&lt; 1) ^ (xi &lt;&lt; 2) ^ (xi &lt;&lt; 3) ^ (xi &lt;&lt; 4);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;sx = (sx &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) ^ (sx &amp; 0xff) ^ 0x63;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;SBOX[x] = sx;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;INV_SBOX[sx] = x;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var x2 = d[x];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var x4 = d[x2];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var x8 = d[x4];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var t = (d[sx] * 0x101) ^ (sx * 0x1010100);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;SUB_MIX_0[x] = (t &lt;&lt; 24) | (t &gt;&gt;&gt; 8);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;SUB_MIX_1[x] = (t &lt;&lt; 16) | (t &gt;&gt;&gt; 16);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;SUB_MIX_2[x] = (t &lt;&lt; 8) | (t &gt;&gt;&gt; 24);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;SUB_MIX_3[x] = t;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var t = (x8 * 0x1010101) ^ (x4 * 0x10001) ^ (x2 * 0x101) ^ (x * 0x1010100);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;INV_SUB_MIX_0[sx] = (t &lt;&lt; 24) | (t &gt;&gt;&gt; 8);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;INV_SUB_MIX_1[sx] = (t &lt;&lt; 16) | (t &gt;&gt;&gt; 16);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;INV_SUB_MIX_2[sx] = (t &lt;&lt; 8) | (t &gt;&gt;&gt; 24);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;INV_SUB_MIX_3[sx] = t;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;if (!x) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; x = xi = 1;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;} else {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; x = x2 ^ d[d[d[x8 ^ x2]]];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; xi ^= d[d[xi]];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }());<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var RCON = [0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08, 0x10, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80, 0x1b, 0x36];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var AES = C_algo.AES = BlockCipher.extend({<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;_doReset: function () {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;if (this._nRounds &amp;&amp; this._keyPriorReset === this._key) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; return;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var key = this._keyPriorReset = this._key;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var keyWords = key.words;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var keySize = key.sigBytes / 4;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var nRounds = this._nRounds = keySize + 6;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var ksRows = (nRounds + 1) * 4;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var keySchedule = this._keySchedule = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;for (var ksRow = 0; ksRow &lt; ksRows; ksRow++) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; if (ksRow &lt; keySize) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;keySchedule[ksRow] = keyWords[ksRow];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; } else {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var t = keySchedule[ksRow - 1];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if (!(ksRow % keySize)) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;t = (t &lt;&lt; 8) | (t &gt;&gt;&gt; 24);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;t = (SBOX[t &gt;&gt;&gt; 24] &lt;&lt; 24) | (SBOX[(t &gt;&gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xff] &lt;&lt; 16) | (SBOX[(t &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xff] &lt;&lt; 8) | SBOX[t &amp; 0xff];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;t ^= RCON[(ksRow / keySize) | 0] &lt;&lt; 24;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;} else if (keySize &gt; 6 &amp;&amp; ksRow % keySize == 4) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;t = (SBOX[t &gt;&gt;&gt; 24] &lt;&lt; 24) | (SBOX[(t &gt;&gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xff] &lt;&lt; 16) | (SBOX[(t &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xff] &lt;&lt; 8) | SBOX[t &amp; 0xff];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;keySchedule[ksRow] = keySchedule[ksRow - keySize] ^ t;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var invKeySchedule = this._invKeySchedule = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;for (var invKsRow = 0; invKsRow &lt; ksRows; invKsRow++) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; var ksRow = ksRows - invKsRow;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; if (invKsRow % 4) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var t = keySchedule[ksRow];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; } else {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var t = keySchedule[ksRow - 4];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; } if (invKsRow &lt; 4 || ksRow &lt;= 4) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;invKeySchedule[invKsRow] = t;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; } else {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;invKeySchedule[invKsRow] = INV_SUB_MIX_0[SBOX[t &gt;&gt;&gt; 24]] ^ INV_SUB_MIX_1[SBOX[(t &gt;&gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xff]] ^ INV_SUB_MIX_2[SBOX[(t &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xff]] ^ INV_SUB_MIX_3[SBOX[t &amp; 0xff]];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}, encryptBlock: function (M, offset) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;this._doCryptBlock(M, offset, this._keySchedule, SUB_MIX_0, SUB_MIX_1, SUB_MIX_2, SUB_MIX_3, SBOX);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}, decryptBlock: function (M, offset) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var t = M[offset + 1];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;M[offset + 1] = M[offset + 3];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;M[offset + 3] = t;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;this._doCryptBlock(M, offset, this._invKeySchedule, INV_SUB_MIX_0, INV_SUB_MIX_1, INV_SUB_MIX_2, INV_SUB_MIX_3, INV_SBOX);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var t = M[offset + 1];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;M[offset + 1] = M[offset + 3];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;M[offset + 3] = t;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}, _doCryptBlock: function (M, offset, keySchedule, SUB_MIX_0, SUB_MIX_1, SUB_MIX_2, SUB_MIX_3, SBOX) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var nRounds = this._nRounds;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var s0 = M[offset] ^ keySchedule[0];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var s1 = M[offset + 1] ^ keySchedule[1];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var s2 = M[offset + 2] ^ keySchedule[2];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var s3 = M[offset + 3] ^ keySchedule[3];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var ksRow = 4;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;for (var round = 1; round &lt; nRounds; round++) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; var t0 = SUB_MIX_0[s0 &gt;&gt;&gt; 24] ^ SUB_MIX_1[(s1 &gt;&gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xff] ^ SUB_MIX_2[(s2 &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xff] ^ SUB_MIX_3[s3 &amp; 0xff] ^ keySchedule[ksRow++];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; var t1 = SUB_MIX_0[s1 &gt;&gt;&gt; 24] ^ SUB_MIX_1[(s2 &gt;&gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xff] ^ SUB_MIX_2[(s3 &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xff] ^ SUB_MIX_3[s0 &amp; 0xff] ^ keySchedule[ksRow++];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; var t2 = SUB_MIX_0[s2 &gt;&gt;&gt; 24] ^ SUB_MIX_1[(s3 &gt;&gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xff] ^ SUB_MIX_2[(s0 &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xff] ^ SUB_MIX_3[s1 &amp; 0xff] ^ keySchedule[ksRow++];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; var t3 = SUB_MIX_0[s3 &gt;&gt;&gt; 24] ^ SUB_MIX_1[(s0 &gt;&gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xff] ^ SUB_MIX_2[(s1 &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xff] ^ SUB_MIX_3[s2 &amp; 0xff] ^ keySchedule[ksRow++];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; s0 = t0;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; s1 = t1;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; s2 = t2;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; s3 = t3;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var t0 = ((SBOX[s0 &gt;&gt;&gt; 24] &lt;&lt; 24) | (SBOX[(s1 &gt;&gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xff] &lt;&lt; 16) | (SBOX[(s2 &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xff] &lt;&lt; 8) | SBOX[s3 &amp; 0xff]) ^ keySchedule[ksRow++];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var t1 = ((SBOX[s1 &gt;&gt;&gt; 24] &lt;&lt; 24) | (SBOX[(s2 &gt;&gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xff] &lt;&lt; 16) | (SBOX[(s3 &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xff] &lt;&lt; 8) | SBOX[s0 &amp; 0xff]) ^ keySchedule[ksRow++];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var t2 = ((SBOX[s2 &gt;&gt;&gt; 24] &lt;&lt; 24) | (SBOX[(s3 &gt;&gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xff] &lt;&lt; 16) | (SBOX[(s0 &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xff] &lt;&lt; 8) | SBOX[s1 &amp; 0xff]) ^ keySchedule[ksRow++];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;var t3 = ((SBOX[s3 &gt;&gt;&gt; 24] &lt;&lt; 24) | (SBOX[(s0 &gt;&gt;&gt; 16) &amp; 0xff] &lt;&lt; 16) | (SBOX[(s1 &gt;&gt;&gt; 8) &amp; 0xff] &lt;&lt; 8) | SBOX[s2 &amp; 0xff]) ^ keySchedule[ksRow++];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;M[offset] = t0;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;M[offset + 1] = t1;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;M[offset + 2] = t2;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;M[offset + 3] = t3;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}, keySize: 256 / 32<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; });<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; C.AES = BlockCipher._createHelper(AES);<br>
}());<br>
<br>
var key = CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse("aZ3uXd2hXupRxvHZ");<br>
var iv = CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse("1513D520B9C1459C");<br>
<br>
function AES_Encrypt(word) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var srcs = CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(word);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; var encrypted = CryptoJS.AES.encrypt(srcs, key, {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;iv: iv,<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;mode: CryptoJS.mode.CBC,<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;padding: CryptoJS.pad.Pkcs7<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; });<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; return encrypted.toString();<br>
}<br>

<br>
function get_data(activityId,watchword){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; json_data={"activityId":Number.parseInt(activityId, 10),"randomCode":"b53c645bf708462aaa12431c6f472151","watchword":watchword,"timestamp":Date.now()}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; sign=AES_Encrypt(JSON.stringify(json_data)).replace(/\+/g, "%2B").replace(/\//g, "%2F")<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; json_data['sign']=sign<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; return json_data<br>
}<br>
console.log(get_data('1704','桃桃安格斯牛'))<br>
